title: MUFG Bank Acquires 20% Stake in Shriram Finance for ₹39,618 Crore ($4.4B)
summary: CCI approves MUFG Bank's acquisition of 20% stake in Shriram Finance for ₹39,618 crore—India's largest cross-border financial services deal.

blocks.text: 🪝 MUFG Bank Acquires 20% Stake in Shriram Finance for ₹39,618 Crore ($4.4B). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: CCI approved Japan's MUFG Bank acquiring a **20% stake in Shriram Finance Ltd for ₹39,618 crore ($4.4 billion)**, marking the largest-ever cross-border investment in India's financial sector.
